scenes.headline: How a data filter gets checked by training, not taste
scenes.sub: Ultra-FineWeb: 1T English and 120B Chinese tokens, and the pipeline behind them.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Licorice! Ultra-FineWeb is a filtered web corpus of about a trillion English tokens. Here's how its filter was built, and what it trades.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: The truth about data is whether training on it helps. Make that check cheap enough to repeat, and filter design becomes a search, not a guess.

steps.say: A quality classifier learns from good and bad examples. Usually, someone's taste picks them.
Here a cheap verification run asks the real question: does training on the data it picks actually help?
Because that check is cheap, it runs again and again, and the seed data itself gets optimised, not asserted.
The classifier is fastText, on purpose: it must run over a trillion tokens, and an LLM per document would be a second pretraining run.

scenes.title: Shipped as stages, not one corpus

steps.say: The release ships stages. L1 is cleaned raw web from Common Crawl: over a trillion tokens, extracted, filtered and deduplicated.
L2 is what the classifier keeps.
L3 rewrites it into questions, answers and new styles: over four hundred billion English tokens, and two hundred billion Chinese.
Because L1 ships too, you can disagree with the filter without redoing the crawl.

left.title: Education filter
items: Loses ground on five of nine
left.say: FineWeb-edu's education filter buys big gains on exam-style benchmarks, but loses ground on five of nine, like everyday commonsense.

right.title: Ultra-FineWeb's verified filter
items: Keeps the ARC and MMLU gains
right.say: Ultra-FineWeb's filter keeps those gains, and regresses on just one benchmark, by zero point one five points.

scenes.text: A filter is a bet about what your model will be asked to do. Check it by training, and publish the losses.
scenes.mark: a bet about what your model will be asked to do

recap: A cheap verification run closes the filter loop
fastText scales the filter to a trillion tokens
L1, L2 and L3 ship as separate tiers
scenes.say: To recap: verify by training, filter with fastText, and ship every tier.
